assignments.essential_function: Prepare comparative income statements,financial metrics and supported movement commentary.
Prepare the comparative financial reporting underlying investor communications.

review: Selected unchanged for comparative monthly/quarterly/annual/YTD income statements, metrics and variance explanations, with balance-sheet/cash-flow reference formats. Original workflow accepts ERP/warehouse data or pasted/uploaded reports. The two-way volume/price decomposition uses current volume for price and reconciles algebraically. Source is broadly GAAP-oriented and expressly requires qualified review before reporting or filings; it is not a jurisdiction-independent accounting authority. No source correction proposed.
native_prerequisites: Trial balance or income-statement data,account hierarchy,comparison periods and known adjustments.
Optional ERP/data warehouse connector; original manual upload/paste fallback is complete.
Qualified financial-professional review is required by upstream; optional /flux drilldown reference is not necessary to produce its listed outputs.
